posts.body:
I am on Cheung Chau Island, so it very easy for me to get to anywhere in quick hitting distance from Central.

How old are your twins? I found in Australia my twins received a lot of attention, but here it is quite over the top. Some days they enjoy all the attention, but at times it becomes stressful for them. 

I am waiting to hear back from the 'moms' group about their activities.

posts.body:
we also have a coffee meet-up on Wednesday afternoons in Pok fu Lam...there seems to be quite a few twin mum's in the area so thought we would (you should see the look on people's faces when we all attend with our babies!). If you wanted to make the effort to come along, you are more than welcome. I sometimes take my 2 year old son along also (who am sure would love your boys). There is also another mum who attends who has a 2 yo son (plus, the twin babies), so could potentially be a good playdate for them.

Pok fu Lam is about 15 mins cab ride from central....unless ferry's from Cheung Chau come into Aberdeen, in which case is very near.

Thanks - that sounds great, we would love to come along. I have just enrolled the boys in a dance class on Wednesday afternon, but when that finishes (in a month I think) we would love to come along. The two year olds sound perfect - my boys don't know they're twins or what twins are anyway .

If it's OK, let me know the details, and we will arrange to attend soon. I think there are some boats that go directly to Aberdeen, if not Central and a cab is very easy.
